implementationBoundaries: Only four complete lowercase keys acquire preferences. No aliases, root parser, native suffix generator, vowel-length heuristic or inferred nasal placement follows from these observations.
Explicit short/long vowels, au, nasal marks, reserved Shift sounds and bare half-consonants retain the fallback rules. Exact custom word entries keep normal precedence.
The target mapping choices reuse development references; the new controls were selected after the design and are not independent human language labels.
Record all control outputs including failures without tuning the new entries or changing the frozen controls.
